label: Igikoresho cyahagaritswe
title: Iki gikoresho cyahagaritswe (kwigana)
message: Iki gikoresho cyahagaritswe n'umugenzuzi wawe (kwigana). Amakuru y'abarwayi arahishwe kandi nta kintu cyoherezwa.
kept_one: Ikintu {{count}} kigumye kuri iki gikoresho kandi nticyoherejwe
kept_other: Ibintu {{count}} bigumye kuri iki gikoresho kandi ntibyoherejwe
keptNone: Nta kintu kitoherejwe kiri kuri iki gikoresho.
restoreHint: Bikuraho ihagarikwa ryiganwa. Ibyagumye byoherezwa mu guhuza gukurikira.
policy: Mu ikoreshwa nyaryo, amabwiriza ku gikoresho cyabuze (urugero gusiba kure cyangwa kohereza mbere) aracyategerejwe. Iri gerageza rigumana amakuru kandi ntiriyohereza.
